crossing.enter: The ring of the portal is cold all through, and nothing is coming back through it.

touch.say: The stone takes the heat out of your palm and gives nothing back. Whatever it cost to come through, it has already been paid.

objects.tap: It's a portal, and it's dead. Cold stone, and a rim worn smooth by hands going one way.

look.say: Scraped raw across all four knuckles. Whatever you were holding, you held it hard, and for a long way.

objects.tap: Your hands. The knuckles are opened and you don't know on what.

study.say: The same shape. A ring, and a line falling through it.
A ring with a line falling through it, cut deep enough to read with a thumb. Your hands know it before you do.

objects.tap: A block set into the wall at chest height, scored over with a shape.

listen.say: Nothing on the other side. Not silence — the sound of a place too big to hear the end of.

open.say: You lift the bar. The shape on the wood is the shape on the stone, and the door is only a door.
The mark on the wood means something. Not to you, and not to your hands.

objects.tap: A low door, barred from this side. The same shape is burned into the wood at eye height.

end.line: The dark takes the third tread, and then you.

descend.say: The cold comes up the steps to meet you. You go down into it.
The door is barred between you and them.

objects.tap: Steps going down past the door, and the dark takes them three treads in.
